senses.gloss: m. (redupl. of פְּרַג) a sprouting bulb, seed-onion.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:3:2">Y. Peah III, 17ᶜ</cite> (expl. <he>אמהות של בצלים</he>, Mish.
ib. III, 4) רב אמר פ׳ Rab says, it is what we call purgarah (R. S. a. l. פּרגד, read: פַּרְגַּר).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:5">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>משיפקל</he>, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:6">ib. I, 6</cite>) <he>מן דו ירים פ׳</he> (not <he>פוד׳</he>, <cite ref="Q00107"><he>פיד׳</he></cite>) when the seed-onion is separated from the onions, v. <cite ref="Q01493"><he>פָּקַל</he></cite>.
